title: 第15章 双胞胎要做我的灵奴我没法拒绝第16章 被双胞胎追杀我要躲进合欢谷
content_zh:
“哥哥，协议你看过啦？要是不同意，现在摇头还来得及呦。”双胞胎笑眯眯地对我说。
我现在眼皮都没法眨一下，怎么摇头？
“嘻嘻，那我们就开始啦！”她们笑得更甜了，“哥哥放心，我们技术好得很，一滴血都不会让你流下来的。”
我的心在滴血。
没想到我也有今天，倒不如来个痛快。
眼前一闪，双胞胎各自拿出一把激光刀，刀刃闪烁着幽蓝的光芒。
我眼珠子动不了，只感觉那道幽蓝光芒慢慢下移，缓缓靠近我的腹部。
我知道她们已经对我动了刀，可我什么感觉都没有。
片刻后，她们站起身，每人捧着一枚淡粉色的蛋。
她们拿走“我的阴阳世界”也就算了，居然还要断我的修炼之路！
我现在要是能晕过去，早就晕了一万遍了。
好吧，我忍了！
等我强大起来，这一切都会拿回来的！
现在我只要记住：她们叫巫沁蓉、巫沛蓉，还有圣女宫宫主圣祀梦！
她们把两枚蛋递给圣祀梦，圣祀梦伸手感知了一下，满意地点了点头。
“师父，他怎么处置？”双胞胎齐声问道。
“他的牙也都是神器，送你们了。”圣祀梦随口说道，“其他的你们看着办就好。”
说完，她拿起装着蛋的两个盒子，身影一闪便消失不见。
双胞胎再次笑嘻嘻地靠近我：“哥哥，拔牙不是我们的专长，可能会有点儿疼呀！”
她们掰开我的嘴，激光刀闪了又闪，我的牙被一颗颗取下来。

这和我控制牙主动脱落不一样，她们是连带着血肉硬生生拔下来的。
这点痛已经不算什么。
我只希望自己能活下去。
“哥哥，你还有什么未了的心愿吗？”她们突然认真地看着我。
我根本无法说话。
心愿已经没有意义，活着才是唯一的心愿。
“哥哥，我送你一颗糖吃吧。”其中一人说道，“甜甜的，吃了所有心愿都能实现！”
她拿出一颗药丸，塞进我嘴里。
我没感觉到任何味道，只看到眼前的双胞胎变成了四胞胎、八胞胎……
……
迷迷糊糊中，我睁开眼睛，发现自己已经回到了阴阳研究学院的住所。
圣祀梦坐在我旁边，笑眯眯地看着我。
双胞胎站在她两侧，低着头红着脸，不敢与我对视。
我悄悄感知了一下身体，居然一切正常。
“灵玉空间”里，大家也像什么都没发生过一样，依旧按部就班。
难道刚才只是个梦？
“哥哥，呜呜……这不是梦！”婧珏突然闪现在“纳虚”里，哭了起来，“我还以为再也见不到你了！”
“到底什么情况？”我急忙问道。
“还好阴阳世界融合了哥哥的神器蛋，成了哥哥的本命神器，属于你生命的一部分，她们抢不走！”
“哈哈，我明白了！”

现在轮到我主场了！
“我说这位漂亮姐姐，不自我介绍一下？”我看向圣祀梦。
“圣祀梦，圣女宫宫主。”她语气沉稳。
“真是久仰大名。我怎么记得，你还是圣女教的教主？”
“哈哈，看来你宝物不少，该记的都没忘掉。”她笑了笑。
content_en:
"Brother, have you read the agreement? If you don't agree, it's still too late to shake your head." The twins said to me with a smile.
I can't even blink my eyelids now, why am I shaking my head?
"Hehe, let's get started!" They smiled even sweeter, "Brother, don't worry, our skills are very good, we won't let you shed even a drop of blood."
My heart is bleeding.
I didn’t expect that I would be here today, so I might as well have a good time.
In a flash before their eyes, the twins each took out a laser knife, the blade flashing with a blue light.
I couldn't move my eyes, I just felt the blue light slowly moving down and approaching my abdomen.
I knew they had stabbed me, but I didn't feel anything.
After a while, they stood up, each holding a pale pink egg.
Even if they took away "my yin and yang world", they actually wanted to interrupt my path of cultivation!
If I could faint now, I would have fainted ten thousand times.
Okay, I can bear it!
When I become stronger, I will get all this back!
Now I just need to remember: their names are Wu Qinrong, Wu Peirong, and the master of the Holy Lady Palace, Shengsi Meng!
They handed the two eggs to Shengsi Meng, who stretched out his hand to feel them and nodded with satisfaction.
"Master, what should we do with him?" the twins asked in unison.
"His teeth are also sacred tools, given to you." Shengsi Meng said casually, "You can take care of the rest."
After saying that, she picked up the two boxes containing the eggs and disappeared in a flash.
The twins approached me with smiles again: "Brother, tooth extraction is not our specialty. It might hurt a little!"
They opened my mouth, the laser knife flashed again and again, and my teeth were removed one by one.
This is different from the fact that I control the teeth to fall out voluntarily. They are pulled out with all their flesh and blood.
This little pain is nothing.
I just hope I can survive.
"Brother, do you have any unfulfilled wishes?" They suddenly looked at me seriously.
I couldn't speak at all.
Wish is meaningless, living is the only wish.
"Brother, let me give you a candy." One of them said, "It's so sweet. If you eat it, all your wishes will come true!"
She took out a pill and popped it into my mouth.
I didn't feel any smell, I just saw the twins in front of me turned into quadruplets, octuplets...
…
Drowsily, I opened my eyes and found that I had returned to the residence of Yin Yang Research Institute.
Shengsi Meng sat next to me and looked at me with a smile.
The twins stood on both sides of her, their heads lowered and their faces red, not daring to look at me.
I quietly felt my body, and everything was normal.
In the "Lingyu Space", everyone acted as if nothing had happened and were still going about their business step by step.
Was it just a dream?
"Brother, wuwu... this is not a dream!" Jingjue suddenly flashed into "Naxu" and cried, "I thought I would never see you again!"
"What's going on?" I asked hurriedly.
"Fortunately, the Yin and Yang world merged with my brother's artifact egg and became my brother's natal artifact. It is part of your life and they can't take it away!"
"Haha, I understand!"
Now it's my turn to play home!
"This beautiful sister, why don't you introduce yourself?" I looked at Shengsi Meng.
"Holy Priest's Dream, Master of the Holy Lady's Palace." She spoke calmly.
"I have long admired your name. How do I remember that you are still the leader of the Saintess Cult?"
"Haha, it seems you have a lot of treasures and you haven't forgotten anything you should remember." She smiled.
